name: Mogitate BasiL! -commencement-
source:
First product of renewed Basil brand.
Includes:

* New mini ADV "Rondo"
* "If... Sore wa Maichiru Sakura no Youni" - additional scenario for [url=/v1115]Sore wa Maichiru Sakura no Youni[/url]
* Reprint edition of visual novels [url=/v1823]21-Two One-[/url] and [url=/v3759]BLESS ~Close Your Eyes, Open Your Mind~[/url]
* Card minigame "Mogi Basi Taisen"
* Wallpapers with popular heroines of Basil Games
* 2 Music CDs
translation:
重启后的Basil品牌推出的第一款产品。
收录内容：

* 新作迷你ADV《Rondo》
* 《If…それは舞い散る桜のように》——为[url=/v1115]《それは舞い散る桜のように》[/url]追加的剧本
* 视觉小说[url=/v1823]《21-Two One-》[/url]与[url=/v3759]《BLESS～Close Your Eyes, Open Your Mind～》[/url]的复刻版
* 卡牌小游戏《Mogi Basi大战》
* 采用Basil游戏人气女主人公绘制的壁纸
* 两张音乐CD
